primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-set-of-iso-classes (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3349-3357

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: for a fixed quasi-coherent module F on U the admissible maps alpha : t*F -> s*F form a (possibly empty) set, since they are elements of a Hom set; the isomorphism classes of kappa-generated quasi-coherent O_U-modules form a set by the cited Properties lemma; indexing by (isomorphism class of F, alpha) gives the desired set T and family (source lines 3359-3367)
